[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Project-note seals: @route^id@, @route:id@, and the project [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]successor prompt[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A project note is sealed with `@`. `@route^id@` creates it, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`@route:id@` creates it and then lets Bryan pick which of its tasks[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]get Pomodoro Task Links in the existing successor choice card. `+` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]typed after `@route^id` now switches to `@route+id`, like every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]other separator. Bob Mac Capture draws both sealed markers as one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]"manila chip" so a project note is easy to spot in a draft.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Seal the caret project-note form with @ in bob[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]seal_grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]seal_grammar: bob-cli switches `@route^id+` to `@route^id@` in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]execution grammar, editor spans, completion, type markers, and `@@` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handling. The old `+` forms are retired with teaching diagnostics. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`capture-parse` emits a separator span and the `project_note: "create"` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]span modifier. `+` after `@route^id` now toggles to `@route+id`. CLI [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]help, docs, and tests are migrated.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]@route:id@ creates the project and offers its tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]offer_form[dim] · [dim][/dim]after seal_grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]offer_form: bob-cli adds the `@route:id@` grammar with `project_note: [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]"offer"` spans, plus sealed `:`/`^` toggles. The project-note planner [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]offers the new note's open tasks (never `^prj`) as successor offers in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`project_note.successors`, using the existing `-p/--pull-in` and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`--require-pull-in-choice` plumbing. A pick renders exactly like a ` :` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bullet. Docs, glossary memory, and tests are updated.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac manila-chip highlighting and @ seal migration[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac_seal[dim] · [dim][/dim]after seal_grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac_seal: Bob Mac Capture decodes the `project_note` span modifier and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the new span kinds. It paints the manila chip: a brown wash, brown name [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and seal, and a green separator and seal for the offer form. It moves [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]picker teaching copy, fake-bob fixtures, and separator-toggle tests from[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`+` to `@`, and updates the Mac docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mac project successor prompt[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac_offer_card[dim] · [dim][/dim]after offer_form, mac_seal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac_offer_card: Bob Mac Capture harvests `project_note.successors` into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the existing Pull-In card. The card shows a "New project" context, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]folder.badge.plus glyph, and a preview row. It applies the initial-marks[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decision, keeps notifications free of double counts, regenerates [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]offer-form fixtures from real bob, and updates the Mac docs.[/#D7D7AF]
